table.retrieve:
SELECT invcode     = dbo.srledger.srinvcode,    
         date        = dbo.srledger.date,    
         flatdisc    = dbo.srledger.flatdisc,  
			salestax    = dbo.srledger.salestax,       
         misccharges = dbo.srledger.misccharges, 
			invdiscperc = dbo.srledger.discperc, 
			invgstperc1 = dbo.srledger.invgstperc1,
			doctype = Case dbo.srledger.srcatcode When 6 Then 'Cash' When 7 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
         dbo.accounts.name, 
         amount =  Round(Sum ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice), 2),    
			itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum (Round( dbo.srdetail.looseqty  * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01),2)), 2),    
    		invdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum (Round( (dbo.srdetail.looseqty  ) * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.srledger.discperc /100), 2) ,
			/*invamount= Round( (Sum(Round((dbo.srdetail.srprice * (dbo.srdetail.looseqty  - (dbo.srdetail.discperc * 0.01))),2))) * ( 1 - (dbo.srledger.discperc * 0.01)) - dbo.srledger.flatdisc + dbo.srledger.misccharges,0),*/
			username=users.username,
			itemsalestax = Sum (Round (dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - dbo.srdetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.srdetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )

    FROM dbo.srledger, 
         dbo.srdetail,   
         dbo.accounts,
			dbo.users  

   WHERE ( dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode ) and  
         ( dbo.srledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
			( dbo.srledger.salesmancode=users.usercode)and
     	   ( dbo.srledger.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            

GROUP BY dbo.srledger.misccharges,   
         dbo.srledger.flatdisc,   
         dbo.srledger.date,   
         dbo.srledger.srinvcode,   
			dbo.srledger.discperc,  
			dbo.srledger.salestax, 
			dbo.srledger.srcatcode, 
			dbo.srledger.invgstperc1, 
			dbo.accounts.name  ,
			dbo.users.username   

ORDER BY dbo.srledger.srinvcode ASC, 
			dbo.srledger.date ASC

objects.name: netamount
objects.expression: Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)  + c_salestaxvalue
